body:
zmux never knows about Emacs, ghostty, umbriel, systemd or notify-send by name. It exposes verbs and a launcher setting; each integration lives where integrations live — the Emacs plugin in the flakes config, window raising in umbriel's IPC, attention via notify-send, birth durability via whatever launcher the caller configures.

Consequences: the core must be usable from elisp, bash and Go without a binding, so its contract is argv plus lines; the launcher is data, not a dependency; and the naming convention lives in one place, the core, so the plugin and the chooser cannot drift from it (the elisp currently duplicates naming, parsing and labels — that duplication is what zmux removes).
title: Integration-blind core, integrations elsewhere
